RETURNING TO MINA
Spend the nights of Tashreeq (the 11th, 12th, and 13th of Dhul-Hijjah) in Mina. If you spend a night elsewhere, you are obligated to offer the sacrifice of a sheep for each night.
If you leave Mina at the beginning of the night, ensure you either reach Mina before midnight or have already departed from Mecca.
However, if you are engaged in completing your Tawaf or Sa’i and find yourself in Mecca in the morning, there is no penalty upon you.
If you leave after midnight, it does not harm you to spend the morning elsewhere.
